data.name: Tip_TriggerWidth
data.value: Width of the edge trigger zone (logical px). The gesture starts only when the cursor is within this distance of the left/right screen edge.

data.name: Tip_Sensitivity
data.value: Minimum unidirectional vertical displacement of one stroke (logical px). Larger = steadier, smaller = more sensitive.

data.name: Tip_RubCount
data.value: Number of alternating vertical strokes needed to trigger (down+up = 2). A value of 1 is easy to trigger accidentally.

data.name: Tip_HoldZoneWidth
data.value: Maximum horizontal drift allowed while rubbing (logical px). Leaving this zone for longer than the grace time abandons the gesture.

data.name: Tip_HoldZoneGrace
data.value: How long (ms) the cursor may stay outside the hold zone before the gesture is abandoned. Returning within this grace period is harmless.

data.name: Tip_NoiseFloor
data.value: Retreat distance (logical px) that counts as a real reversal. Smaller wiggles are treated as hand jitter and ignored.

data.name: Tip_FirstSegmentTimeout
data.value: Time budget (ms) for the first stroke after entering the edge. Prevents an idle cursor parked at the edge from staying armed forever.

data.name: Tip_InterSegmentTimeout
data.value: Maximum pause (ms) allowed between consecutive strokes.

data.name: Tip_Cooldown
data.value: Cooldown (ms) after a trigger. Only the edge that just fired cools down; the other edge can trigger immediately.

data.name: Tip_JumpThreshold
data.value: A single-sample displacement beyond this (logical px) is treated as a teleport (monitor hop, automation) and resets the gesture.

data.name: Tip_DisableFullscreen
data.value: Automatically disable gestures while a fullscreen app (e.g. a game) is active on any monitor.

data.name: Tip_Blocklist
data.value: Gestures are disabled while any listed process exists. Process name without .exe, case-insensitive (e.g. game).

data.name: Tip_AutoStart
data.value: Start automatically at Windows logon (registry Run key; the path self-heals if you move the exe).

data.name: Tip_EnableLogging
data.value: Write gesture-recognition and gate events to the diagnostic log (%AppData%\DeskFlip\deskflip.log, self-trimming at ~50 KB). Off by default; enable when troubleshooting.

data.name: Tip_ZoneVisualization
data.value: While this window is open, draw semi-transparent overlays on the screen edges: blue = trigger zone, green = hold zone. Updates live as you change parameters.

data.name: Tip_Paused
data.value: Pause all gesture recognition. Synced with the tray right-click menu.

data.name: Tip_Language
data.value: UI language. Takes effect after restarting the app.
